verdict.rationale: The public guidance pages at open.gsa.gov (entity-api and the API index) were retrieved and their text content extracted, which indicates server-rendered, readable pages. The robots probe returned HTTP 200 with a standard crawl policy that leaves content paths crawlable to a keyless agent, and the 404 probes show plain server responses rather than a challenge page. Missing for 10: a direct probe confirming the HTML guidance pages return 200 to an identified user agent with no CAPTCHA or bot challenge, and evidence that sam.gov's own pages are not a JS-only shell.
